turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I didn't come for thanks. I asked you a question, and I'm still waiting for the answer.
Ms. Kalinowski, you're a lawyer. Honestly, what would you do in my position?
You want me to do your job for you now? Take the zero off, Hale, and then show me whatever you think justifies this.
No really, give me advice. How should I handle this?
I'm on the other side of this table, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or tell me what you've got.
